title: Clerk logo strip
description: A calm customer-logo row on white: five evenly spaced wordmarks on desktop, a 2×2 grid on phones. Each slot quietly swaps between two logos with a soft fade, blur and lift, staggered across the row.
notes: logos fill five slots; logo n and n+5 share a slot and take turns (phones show the first four slots)
CSS only; with reduced motion each slot keeps its first logo
